summary: Design hybrid learning that works. Build storyboards, LMS plans, and performance support with practical blended learning methods.
lede: EdTech integration in blended learning connects digital tools, facilitator-led sessions, and performance support in one coherent experience. Designed for professionals who already design, deliver, or manage learning programs, the course helps them map outcomes to delivery formats, create storyboards and job aids, and plan LMS and virtual delivery. It also covers assessment and learner analytics to evaluate engagement and learning transfer.
audienceIntro: This advanced course is designed for professionals who already design, deliver, or manage learning programs and now need to integrate technology with blended learning discipline.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Working experience in training delivery, curriculum design, learning administration, or HR development is recommended. You should already understand basic adult learning concepts and have access to a laptop for course design exercises. No programming is required, but familiarity with learning management systems, virtual classroom tools, or digital content review workflows will help you get more value from the hands-on work. Advanced concepts such as learner analytics and digital assessment design are taught at an operational application level, not as software engineering or platform administration.
